project.name: dandori
project.description: Dandori is a meal-planning co-pilot for a few invited users cooking for themselves: it plans batch-cooked meals, tracks kitchen inventory, adapts to schedule changes and fills an online supermarket cart. Built in Go with templ, htmx, PostgreSQL/pgvector and Claude.

nodes.name: Meal Planning
nodes.summary: The Plan over a Cycle: the stretch one supermarket Delivery has to last, the Slots that must be filled, the Prep Sessions that fill them and the Plan Proposal the agent asks the User to approve. Holds the rules that judge a draft Plan and the replanning that repairs it once the schedule changes.

businessRules: There is one Plan per Cycle and it changes only through an approved Plan Proposal.
At most one Plan Proposal is pending, or one planning Run going, at a time across all Cycles.
A Plan Proposal replaces the Plan only from a Slot whose time of day is still to come.
The Verdict shows the hard rules a draft Plan breaks and the soft misses against the User's Targets.
Rejecting a Plan Proposal with a Planning Note asks for another, from the first Slot not yet prepared.
A Cycle's end date moves only through an approved Plan Proposal.
crossDomainInteractions: Reads the Kitchen Ledger's forecast of what the kitchen will hold at each Slot.
Reads the Recipe Library, the known Ingredients and the Planner's own Recipe Drafts.
Starts its planning Runs in the Agent Engine and judges what they submit.
Decides the Grocery List of a Cycle through the Plan it leaves.
Reads the Profile's Targets, Slot times and Planning Brief.

nodes.name: Kitchen Ledger
nodes.summary: What the kitchen holds is never stored as such: it is what the append-only record of Movements adds up to at a moment. Stock Items and Portion Lots are computed from it, and every Count, move, put-away and assumed Preparation is one more Movement that is never edited.

businessRules: A correction is a new Movement, never an edit: the Ledger is append-only.
A Movement never happened before one it was checked against.
Quantities are exact tenths, rounded up only where a Grocery List asks for whole units.
An assumed Movement is recorded once, when its time passes; changing the Plan later never changes it.
Marking an Ingredient a Staple counts each Stock Item of it to nothing.
Counting Portions down takes those without a Slot first, then the one with the latest Slot.
crossDomainInteractions: The Planning domain walks it to record what the Plan assumed happened.
The Groceries domain puts a Delivery away into it as Stock Items.
The Ingredients domain refuses to change a unit a Movement has fixed.

nodes.name: Groceries
nodes.summary: The Grocery List of a Cycle: what its Plan needs beyond what the kitchen will hold, rounded up to whole units with the Staples named apart. The list follows the Plan until the User marks the Delivery ordered, which fixes it, and the Delivery is put away into the kitchen when it arrives.

businessRules: The Grocery List follows the Plan until the Delivery is marked ordered, which fixes it.
A Delivery is marked ordered only once its Cycle has a Plan.
An Ingredient with no Product Mapping is listed at what is needed, rounded up to a whole unit.
Staples are named apart: no Grocery List buys them.
Once the Delivery arrives everything on it becomes Stock Items, the rounding surplus included.
crossDomainInteractions: Reads the Plan of a Cycle and the forecast of what the kitchen will hold when the Delivery arrives.
Writes the put-away of a Delivery into the Kitchen Ledger as Movements.
Today shows the put-away list to the User.

nodes.name: Recipes & Ingredients
nodes.summary: The Recipe Library the User keeps and the Ingredients they measure, each with a unit, its nutritional values and its usual Storage Location. Pasted recipe text is read by a parse Run into a Recipe Draft, which the User checks before it joins the Library.

businessRules: No two of a User's Recipes share a name.
Each food is one Ingredient; only a nutritionally different food makes another.
A Recipe reuses existing Ingredients and adds a new one only once the User confirms its nutritional values.
An Ingredient's unit cannot change while a Movement, a Recipe or a Plan refers to it.
A Recipe Draft belongs to the Run that wrote it, or to the Plan Proposal that drafted it, until it is accepted or discarded.
Every Food Term is in the User's Language, whatever language it arrived in.
crossDomainInteractions: The Planning domain's planner reads the Library and drafts Recipes with its Plan Proposal.
The Kitchen Ledger fixes an Ingredient's unit and holds its Movements.
The Agent Engine runs the parse that reads pasted text.

nodes.name: Agent Engine
nodes.summary: A Run is one execution of an agent task, from its start until it succeeds, fails or is cancelled. A hand-written tool-use loop carries a Brief against the model, runs the tools the model calls and turns every step into a Trace Event the User can follow live.

businessRules: A Run ends succeeded, failed or cancelled, and a Run still going when the app stops counts as failed.
Cancelling a Run rolls nothing back: what it already did stays.
A cancelled planning Run produces no Plan Proposal.
The span of a model call says the model, the tokens and why it stopped, never what it was asked or said.
crossDomainInteractions: The Planning domain starts its planning Runs with its own Brief and tools.
The Recipes domain starts the parse Runs that read pasted text.
The Runs page shows the Trace of every Run in the User's Language.

nodes.name: The User
nodes.summary: One person cooking for themselves, with their own kitchen and nothing shared. The Profile holds the Language, the Targets, the time of day of each kind of Slot, the Meal Out estimate, the foods to avoid, the appliances owned and the Planning Brief. Signing in is by magic link.

businessRules: The Language can change only until the User has written a Food Term; after that it stays.
The Targets are aimed at, never enforced: missing one never stops a Plan Proposal.
The Planning Brief is written only by the User and applies from the next planning Run.
Every table belongs to one User, scoped by row-level security in the database.
The appliances owned are the only ones a Plan's Recipes may need.
crossDomainInteractions: The Planning domain reads the Targets, the Slot times and the Planning Brief.
The Recipes domain writes the Food Terms that fix the Language.
The shared web layer writes every page and message in the User's Language.

nodes.name: Opening a Cycle
nodes.summary: The User opens the stretch one supermarket Delivery has to last: the typed Delivery's day and window, and the end date the Cycle lasts to. The Cycle's status and its Slots are derived from the clock, never stored.

nodes.name: Refuse a second upcoming Cycle
nodes.summary: Says why the User cannot open a Cycle now: no Targets set yet, or a Cycle already upcoming. Cycles never overlap and at most one is upcoming.

nodes.name: Read the typed Delivery and end date
nodes.summary: Reads the Cycle as the User typed it, in the Language's order of day and month, with a problem for each field refused.

nodes.name: Derive the Cycle's status and its Slots
nodes.summary: The status of each Cycle at the clock's now: upcoming until its Delivery arrives, current until the next one's does, then closed. The Cycle's Slots run from the first after its Delivery arrives to the last of its end date, at the Profile's times of day.

nodes.name: Save the Cycle under the planning lock
nodes.summary: Opens the Cycle for the signed-in User at the clock's now, under the planning lock so no second planning goes for it.

nodes.name: Planning a Cycle
nodes.summary: The User asks for the Cycle to be planned. A planning Run is told the Profile, the Planning Brief and Notes, the Recipe Library and the kitchen forecast, and submits a draft Plan that is judged against the hard rules before it becomes a Plan Proposal.

nodes.name: Run the Kitchen Check
nodes.summary: The User's confirmation, before an upcoming Cycle is planned, of every Portion and Stock Item the kitchen is believed to hold today. Skipping it counts as confirming.

nodes.name: Take the planning turn
nodes.summary: Says whether the Run may plan the Cycle now, under the planning lock: a first Plan, changes, or neither.

nodes.name: Read what planning needs of the kitchen and the Library
nodes.summary: Reads the Library, the stock, the approved Plans and the forecast at the Slot planning starts from, and the Plan of the Cycle as its approved proposals leave it.

nodes.name: Build the planning Run's Brief
nodes.summary: The system prompt, the stable block of the Profile, the Recipe Library and the known Ingredients, and the prompt with the Cycle, the Planning Brief and Notes, the kitchen forecast and the days before.

nodes.name: Run the agent's tool-use loop
nodes.summary: The hand-written loop carries the Brief against the model and runs the tools it calls: check_plan, submit_plan and draft_recipe.

nodes.name: Judge the draft Plan and store the Plan Proposal
nodes.summary: The check_plan tool reads the draft Plan and says which hard rules it breaks; submit_plan stores it as the Cycle's Plan Proposal when it keeps every hard rule, and fails the Run after three that break one.

nodes.name: Show the Verdict and the Plan Proposal
nodes.summary: The Cycle page shows the proposal's own Verdict first: the hard rules broken, the days it plans, the misses against the Targets and the Portions it makes for after the Cycle.

nodes.name: Deciding on a Plan Proposal
nodes.summary: The User approves a Plan Proposal, making it the Cycle's Plan, or rejects it with a Planning Note that asks the planner for another. An approved proposal replaces the Plan only from a Slot whose time is still to come.

nodes.name: Bring the kitchen up to now
nodes.summary: Every page brings the kitchen up to now first, so the Prep Sessions before the proposal's first Slot have already happened.

nodes.name: Read the pending proposal and its Verdict
nodes.summary: The stored Proposal with its Recipes, Ingredients, Portions and Recipe Drafts found by id, and how planning the Cycle stands.

nodes.name: Approve: make it the Cycle's Plan
nodes.summary: The pending Plan Proposal becomes the Cycle's Plan, and its Recipe Drafts are accepted into the User's Recipe Library as drafted.

nodes.name: Reject with a Planning Note
nodes.summary: A rejection with a note asks for another Plan, starting a planning Run of the Cycle from the rejected one's first Slot, or from the first Slot not yet prepared.

nodes.name: Apply the approved proposal over the Plan it replaces
nodes.summary: What a Plan Proposal replaces and keeps of a Plan over a range of Slots: the Prep Sessions before it stay, and their Portions not yet eaten are the proposal's to put in Slots again.

nodes.name: Show the Plan by day
nodes.summary: The approved Plan shown day by day: the Prep Sessions, the Portion filling each Slot and the soft misses against the Targets.

nodes.name: Asking for Changes to a Plan
nodes.summary: The User asks the planner to change the Plan of an upcoming or current Cycle, with a Planning Note. A replan starts from the first Slot not yet prepared and the Plan stays as it is until the new proposal is approved.

nodes.name: Check that nothing is pending and no Run is going
nodes.summary: Asking to plan waits its turn: it is refused while a Plan Proposal is pending or a planning Run is going.

nodes.name: Start the replan from the first Slot not yet prepared
nodes.summary: A planning Run starts from the first Slot still to come, told what the kitchen holds, carrying the User's Planning Note.

nodes.name: Carry the Planning Note into the Run's prompt
nodes.summary: Every planning Run of a Cycle is told all its Planning Notes, newest first, and a newer one wins where they disagree.

nodes.name: Mark what the new proposal changes
nodes.summary: What a Plan Proposal changes of the Plan it replaces: the Slots it fills with other food, the Prep Sessions it drops and the freezer splits it changes.

nodes.name: Plan again after a failed Run
nodes.summary: A failed planning Run offers to plan again, without the Kitchen Check, starting the Cycle over from its first Slot still to come.

nodes.name: Show the replan going or failed
nodes.summary: The Cycle page says that a replan is going, or that it failed, so the User knows what happened to their Plan.

nodes.name: Today
nodes.summary: What the User sees when they open the app: the whole day's Slots with the next one first, when to start preparing and with what, what to take out of the freezer tonight, a Delivery due and the next Cycle to plan.

nodes.name: Read the day at the clock's now
nodes.summary: Reads what Today shows at the moment: the day's Slots, the beat, the reminders and the offer.

nodes.name: Bring the kitchen up to now
nodes.summary: The Plan is taken to happen as dated: the assumed Movements of deliveries, Prep Sessions and Slots are recorded before the day is shown.

nodes.name: Say the day's Slots, the next one first
nodes.summary: The day's Slots as they are now and next at the clock's now, at the Profile's time of day for each kind.

nodes.name: Say what to take out of the freezer tonight
nodes.summary: What the Plan's Prep Sessions thaw the evening before, worked out from the Plan holding the next day's Slots and what the kitchen will hold outside the freezer.

nodes.name: Say what the Delivery brings and where it goes
nodes.summary: The put-away list of a Delivery due: where each line of the Grocery List goes, most in its usual Storage Location and some in the freezer by the Plan's splits.

nodes.name: Remind the next Cycle to plan and offer to open one
nodes.summary: The next Cycle to plan and order, from three days before the current Cycle's end date, and what the User may do about it now.

nodes.name: Counting the Kitchen
nodes.summary: The User corrects what the kitchen holds by saying how much of a Stock Item, or of a Portion Lot, is really there. The Count becomes a Movement of the difference, keeping both what was believed and what was stated.

nodes.name: Read the Count as typed
nodes.summary: Reads a Count of a unit as the User typed it, with problems by field, and says why a quantity is refused.

nodes.name: Hold the User's kitchen lock
nodes.summary: The Ledger's write side takes the signed-in User's kitchen lock and hands the writer the Ledger as it stands, so two writes cannot interleave.

nodes.name: Write the Count as a Movement
nodes.summary: The Count, written at now, that a Stock Item holds a stated quantity, keeping both what was believed and what was stated.

nodes.name: Save the Movement in the Kitchen Ledger
nodes.summary: Appends the Movement to the signed-in User's Kitchen Ledger, with the Portions it touches.

nodes.name: Count a Portion Lot down
nodes.summary: The Portions of the lot a Count down takes: those without a Slot first, then the one with the latest Slot. A Portion a replan moves is eaten at its new Slot.

nodes.name: Show what the kitchen holds now
nodes.summary: Reads what the Kitchen Ledger adds up to at now: the Stock Items held, by Storage Location and then name, and the Portion Lots.

nodes.name: Moving Stock between Storage Locations
nodes.summary: The User moves stock, or Portions of a Portion Lot, from one Storage Location to another: pantry, fridge or freezer. A transfer is one ledger event, not a removal and an addition.

nodes.name: Read the move as typed
nodes.summary: Reads the quantity to move from one Storage Location to another, with problems by field.

nodes.name: Check the Stock Item holds enough to move
nodes.summary: Says why a move is refused from a Stock Item holding a quantity, if it is: a move never takes stock below nothing.

nodes.name: Write the move as one Movement
nodes.summary: The move, written at now, of a quantity from a Stock Item to another Storage Location, carrying where it went.

nodes.name: Move Portions to another Portion Lot
nodes.summary: The Movement that moves Portions of a Portion Lot to another lot in another Storage Location; the same food elsewhere is another lot.

nodes.name: Save the Movement
nodes.summary: Appends the Movement to the Kitchen Ledger in the order it happened.

nodes.name: Adding Portions by Hand
nodes.summary: The User adds Portions Dandori never saw made: someone else cooked it, or it came from elsewhere. They join the Portion Lot of the same name and values in the Storage Location they name.

nodes.name: Read the typed Portions and how many
nodes.summary: Reads typed Portions into new ones, nutrition by field, with a problem per field refused, and how many to add.

nodes.name: Find the Portion Lot they join
nodes.summary: Finds the Portion Lot alike a Portion in a Storage Location, as the kitchen holds it: the same name and nutritional values.

nodes.name: Refuse a lot that cannot hold them
nodes.summary: Says why more Portions alike cannot join the lot: a lot holds at most 99.

nodes.name: Write the Movement that adds the Portions
nodes.summary: The Movement, written at now, that adds Portions to a Storage Location.

nodes.name: Save the Portions with the Movement
nodes.summary: Saves how many Portions the Movement says the User has, and their ids, holding the kitchen first.

nodes.name: The Plan Happening in Time
nodes.summary: The Plan is taken to happen as dated: at each Slot's time a Prep Session is prepared, its Ingredients used up and its Portions made, and a Portion is eaten once its Slot's time is past. What the app assumes is recorded once, when its time passes.

nodes.name: Beat: bring every User's kitchen up to now
nodes.summary: The scheduler's beat brings every User's kitchen up to the moment, logging one User's failure without stopping the others.

nodes.name: Walk the Plan from the last moment to now
nodes.summary: Walks the kitchen up to a moment: the Movements a Plan's deliveries, Prep Sessions and Slots write, in the order they happen.

nodes.name: Record the assumed Movements
nodes.summary: A Prep Session uses up its Ingredients and prepares its Portions, one Movement per Storage Location; a Slot's Portion is eaten.

nodes.name: Save the Portions that were prepared
nodes.summary: Saves the Portions the Prep Session made, each recording its Planned Portion, holding the kitchen first.

nodes.name: Mark the kitchen as brought up to now
nodes.summary: Records the kitchen as brought up to now, and the scheduler's beat, so the walk never repeats a moment.

nodes.name: The Grocery List of a Cycle
nodes.summary: What the Cycle's Plan needs minus the stock the kitchen will hold when its Delivery arrives, rounded up to whole units, with the Staples named apart for the User to check.

nodes.name: Read the Cycle's Plan
nodes.summary: The Plan of the Cycle as its approved Plan Proposals leave it in place, as far as the Cycle lasts.

nodes.name: Forecast what the kitchen will hold
nodes.summary: The kitchen forecast at the Slot the Delivery arrives: what it holds of each Stock Item, the Portion Lots without a Slot, and what an ordered Delivery brings, put away.

nodes.name: Work out what is short and round it up
nodes.summary: The Grocery List of a Plan against the stock the kitchen holds: a line for each Ingredient short, rounded up to a whole unit, with the Staples named apart.

nodes.name: Show the Grocery List
nodes.summary: The list is shown on the Cycle page, and it follows the Plan until the Delivery is marked ordered.

nodes.name: Marking the Delivery Ordered
nodes.summary: Having checked out on the supermarket's site by hand, the User marks the Delivery ordered, which fixes the Grocery List as it stands. They can undo that until it arrives.

nodes.name: Refuse until the Cycle has a Plan
nodes.summary: Reports whether the Grocery List of the Cycle is still fixed as the lines given; a Delivery is marked ordered only once its Cycle has a Plan.

nodes.name: Fix the Grocery List as it stands
nodes.summary: Marks the Delivery of the upcoming Cycle ordered, fixing its Grocery List as it stands at that moment.

nodes.name: Undo the order
nodes.summary: Makes the Delivery tentative again, dropping the fixed Grocery List, while it has not arrived.

nodes.name: Putting Away a Delivery
nodes.summary: When the Delivery arrives, everything on its Grocery List becomes Stock Items, put away in the Ingredient's usual Storage Location unless the Plan splits one: some of a fresh Ingredient used late in the Cycle goes in the freezer.

nodes.name: See which Deliveries are due to be put away
nodes.summary: Reads what each of the User's Deliveries arrived by now and is not put away yet brings.

nodes.name: Work out where each line goes
nodes.summary: Where a Delivery puts its Grocery List away, by the Plan's freezer splits, each line in its usual Storage Location.

nodes.name: Write the put-away as Movements
nodes.summary: The Movements, written at now, of putting a Delivery away as its put-away lines become Stock Items.

nodes.name: Mark the Delivery as put away
nodes.summary: The Cycle's Delivery is put away once, and Today stops showing where its lines go at the end of the day after its day.

nodes.name: Show the put-away list on Today
nodes.summary: Today shows where each line of the Grocery List goes, and the User can count or move a line straight from the page.

nodes.name: Writing and Editing a Recipe
nodes.summary: The User writes or edits a Recipe in the Library: its Ingredients with their quantities, its steps, the appliances it needs, the Portions it makes and the kinds of Slot they may be eaten at.

nodes.name: Read the Recipe as typed
nodes.summary: Reads a Recipe as the User typed it, with what is wrong with it and why it is refused.

nodes.name: Refuse a name the User already has
nodes.summary: No two of a User's Recipes share a name; a Recipe with a taken name is refused in the transaction that would have added it.

nodes.name: Add the Recipe with its new Ingredients
nodes.summary: Adds a Recipe for the User with the Ingredients it lists that the User does not have yet, all or nothing.

nodes.name: Edit a Recipe
nodes.summary: Sets the Recipe to the given one, adding its new Ingredients. Editing changes only what is yet to be recorded: Portions already prepared keep their name and values.

nodes.name: Delete a Recipe
nodes.summary: Deletes the Recipe with its own rows, refusing one a Plan prepares.

nodes.name: Show the Library and the form
nodes.summary: The Recipe Library is listed and searched, and the form shows the Ingredient rows the User typed.

nodes.name: Parsing Pasted Recipe Text
nodes.summary: The User pastes recipe text and a parse Run reads it into a Recipe Draft: the model is given the known Ingredients and the one tool it may call, and what it submits is checked against the User's Ingredients before it is stored.

nodes.name: Start the parse Run
nodes.summary: Starts a parse Run reading the pasted text into a Recipe Draft, and is the Run's id.

nodes.name: Build the parse Run's Brief
nodes.summary: The system prompt, the known Ingredients and the pasted text, and the one tool the model may call.

nodes.name: Run the agent's tool-use loop
nodes.summary: The hand-written loop carries the Brief against the model and runs the tool it calls.

nodes.name: Check the Recipe the model submitted
nodes.summary: Each Ingredient is resolved to the one of the User's it is, or kept as new with the values proposed, and the problems a Recipe can't have are collected.

nodes.name: Tell the model what to fix
nodes.summary: The problems, by field path, are handed back to the model so it can correct them and try again.

nodes.name: Store the Recipe Draft the Run leaves
nodes.summary: The Draft the parse Run left is stored with the Run, awaiting the User's check.

nodes.name: Checking a Recipe Draft
nodes.summary: Before a Recipe joins the Library the User checks what the Run read: they accept it, with its new Ingredients and their values, or discard it. The planner's Drafts are checked as part of their Plan Proposal, never on their own.

nodes.name: Read the Draft with its Ingredients resolved
nodes.summary: Reads the Draft with each Ingredient resolved to the User's own and the text its Run read.

nodes.name: Show the Draft for checking
nodes.summary: The Draft is shown in a side sheet, in the User's Language, with the values to confirm or edit.

nodes.name: Accept the Draft into the Library
nodes.summary: Adds what the User made of the Draft as a Recipe and deletes the draft, all or nothing: a refused accept changes nothing.

nodes.name: Discard the Draft
nodes.summary: Deletes the Recipe Draft the Run left; nothing of it joins the Library.

nodes.name: Check the planner's Draft
nodes.summary: A Recipe Draft the planner drafted is read against the Library and the Ingredients, and refused when it no longer fits either.

nodes.name: Accept the planner's Drafts with the proposal
nodes.summary: Approving a Plan Proposal accepts the Recipe Drafts it prepares into the Library, as drafted; rejecting it discards them.

nodes.name: Managing Ingredients
nodes.summary: The User adds the foods they measure, each with a unit, its nutritional values and its usual Storage Location, and edits or deletes them later. A name close to one they have is suggested rather than taken.

nodes.name: Read the Ingredient as typed
nodes.summary: Reads the Ingredient as the User typed it: its name and key, its unit, its usual Storage Location and its nutritional values, with a problem per field refused.

nodes.name: Refuse a name already taken
nodes.summary: Each food is one Ingredient: a name the User already has is refused unless they confirmed it.

nodes.name: Suggest the Ingredient a mistyped name meant
nodes.summary: Finds the known Ingredient a mistyped name meant, by one-slip matching and trigram similarity, so the User can take it rather than add a second one.

nodes.name: Refuse a unit a Movement, a Recipe or a Plan has fixed
nodes.summary: An Ingredient's unit cannot change while a Movement refers to it, and one a Recipe lists or a Plan uses cannot be deleted at all.

nodes.name: Search the User's Ingredients
nodes.summary: The User's Ingredients a search finds by spelling, the most alike first, and a near miss is named as a suggestion.

nodes.name: Delete an Ingredient nothing refers to
nodes.summary: Deletes the Ingredient, retrying once a row came to refer to it as it went, and refusing one Movements, a Recipe or a Plan refer to.

nodes.name: Running a Task
nodes.summary: A Run is one execution of an agent task: planning a Cycle, parsing a pasted Recipe. It is recorded, carried out in the background as the User it belongs to, and every step of the loop becomes a Trace Event.

nodes.name: Record the Run and start it in the background
nodes.summary: Records a new Run of a kind for the signed-in User and carries it out in the background as that User.

nodes.name: Ask the model, retrying the failures worth retrying
nodes.summary: Asks the model with the Brief's system prompt, stable block and prompt, retrying the failures worth retrying with a growing wait.

nodes.name: Run the tools the model calls, in order
nodes.summary: Runs the tool calls of the model's turn in order, reporting a failing tool back to the model instead of failing the Run.

nodes.name: Record every step as a Trace Event
nodes.summary: Emits a Trace Event with the Run, in order, and sends it to everyone following the Run.

nodes.name: Store what the Run leaves with its success
nodes.summary: Carries the Run out and records how it ended, storing what it leaves in the same transaction as its success.

nodes.name: Span the model call under the Run's
nodes.summary: Makes each call to the model a client span under the Run's, saying the model, the tokens and why it stopped, never what it was asked or said.

nodes.name: Following a Trace
nodes.summary: The User sees the Runs they own and can follow one live: its Trace Events stream in as the Run goes, and are kept with the Run after it ends.

nodes.name: List the User's Runs
nodes.summary: The signed-in User's Runs, newest first, without their Traces.

nodes.name: Read one Run with its Trace
nodes.summary: The signed-in User's Run with its Trace, the kind of task it was and how it ended.

nodes.name: Follow the Trace live
nodes.summary: Follows a Run's Trace Events from now on, while it goes in this process, and streams them to the page over SSE.

nodes.name: Show the Trace in the User's Language
nodes.summary: Every fixed line of a Run's Trace and page is written in English or Italian, so the User reads what the agent did.

nodes.name: Cancelling a Run
nodes.summary: The User cancels a Run that is going. Cancelling rolls nothing back: what the Run already did stays, and running it again finishes the work.

nodes.name: Cancel the Run if it is going
nodes.summary: Cancels the signed-in User's Run if it is going, storing it cancelled before it stops.

nodes.name: Store it cancelled with the document its page tells
nodes.summary: Stores a Run cancelled in a transaction, with the document its kind's page tells.

nodes.name: Stop the Run's work
nodes.summary: The function the cancellation returns stops the Run's loop and waits for it to record how it ended.

nodes.name: Fail the Runs a crash left going
nodes.summary: Fails every Run still stored as going, as a crash leaves one, ending its Trace as a graceful stop's.

nodes.name: Signing In
nodes.summary: A User signs in with a magic link: they ask for it by email, redeem it, and the session is kept in cookies until they sign out. Their own User is created at their first sign-in.

nodes.name: Ask for the magic link
nodes.summary: Emails a magic link, treating a refusal from Supabase as no error: whether the email was invited is never told.

nodes.name: Redeem the link and create the User
nodes.summary: Signs in with the magic link's token hash and creates the User at their first sign-in.

nodes.name: Keep the session in cookies
nodes.summary: The session is kept in cookies and the User is carried on the request, so a forged or unreadable token is refused.

nodes.name: Refresh an expired access token
nodes.summary: Tells who the tokens sign in, refreshing the session when the access token has expired.

nodes.name: Sign out
nodes.summary: Ends the session at Supabase, refreshing an expired access token first.

nodes.name: Choosing a Language
nodes.summary: The one Language a User's Dandori speaks: its pages and every Food Term. It is asked for at the first sign-in and can change only until the User writes their first Food Term.

nodes.name: Ask for the Language at the first sign-in
nodes.summary: The Language choice is asked for once, the first time the User opens Dandori.

nodes.name: Save the chosen Language
nodes.summary: Chooses or changes the User's Language, refusing it once they have written a Food Term or a parse Run is going.

nodes.name: Write every page and message in that Language
nodes.summary: The shared i18n layer gives the Language of the request and the date, time and number formats each Language writes, so every page is written the way the User reads.

nodes.name: Keeping the Profile
nodes.summary: The User's stored settings: the Targets their meals are aimed at, the time of day of each kind of Slot, the Meal Out estimate, the foods to avoid, the appliances they own and the Planning Brief every planning Run reads.

nodes.name: Read the Profile whole
nodes.summary: Reads the signed-in User's Profile at once, so every section of the page shows what is stored.

nodes.name: Save the Targets
nodes.summary: Saves the typed Targets, refusing each field that is wrong on its own: calories as a range with the tolerance either side, protein and fibre as floors, sugar as a ceiling.

nodes.name: Save the time of day of each kind of Slot
nodes.summary: Saves the typed time of day of each kind of Slot, or refuses each field that is wrong; Today then follows them.

nodes.name: Save the Meal Out estimate
nodes.summary: Saves the typed Meal Out estimate, refusing each field that is wrong: the default nutrition of a meal eaten out.

nodes.name: Save the exclusions and allergies
nodes.summary: Saves the typed exclusions and allergies as the User's, each normalised in lower case with blanks and repeats dropped.

nodes.name: Save the appliances owned
nodes.summary: Saves the ticked kinds as those the User owns, with their notes; they are the only ones a Plan's Recipes may need.

nodes.name: Save the Planning Brief
nodes.summary: Saves the typed Planning Brief, trimmed; it is the User's lasting wishes for how their meals are planned, and applies from the next planning Run.

edges.description: Planning forecasts what the Kitchen Ledger will hold at each Slot and brings the kitchen up to now before it judges a Plan.
The planner reads the Recipe Library and the known Ingredients, and drafts new Recipes that travel with its Plan Proposal.
The Plan a Cycle leaves is what its Grocery List is worked out from.
Every planning of a Cycle is a Run of the agent engine, given its own Brief and its three tools.
The planner aims at the Profile's Targets and follows the Planning Brief, at the Slot times the Profile fixes.
A Delivery's put-away is written into the Kitchen Ledger as the Movements that become Stock Items.
The Movements of an Ingredient fix its unit and its name, so the Ingredients service refuses to change them.
The Staples of the Grocery List are the Ingredients the User marked as always in the kitchen.
A pasted Recipe is read by a parse Run of the agent engine, and the planner's Drafts are drafted by one.
The Food Terms the Recipes domain writes are what fix the User's Language for good.
A planning Run leaves a Plan Proposal and its Verdict behind; a cancelled one leaves none.
